title: The Society of Saint Maur Incorporation (Amendment) Bill
what_it_is: The Society of Saint Maur Incorporation (Amendment) Bill

sections.label: Select Committee Bill Report
sections.summary: The Select Committee considered the Bill, made minor textual alterations, and presented its Report to Parliament on 17 January 2024.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The Select Committee requested further details and received a statutory declaration from Sister Lau Wai Leng Maria, which also provided supporting documents.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The Select Committee has considered the Bill and has only made minor textual alterations to the Bill to reflect the change in citation year from 2023 to 2024.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The Committee’s Report was presented to Parliament on 17 January 2024.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The passing of the Bill, with its update of name references in the Ordinance, will give recognition to the distinct identity of the Lady Superior, and IJ Sisters, in Singapore.
